name: Order Command Center
description: Local order desk: validate, score fraud and margin, then route quarantine, rejection, review, backorder, parcel, and pickup. Sample data only.

parameters.content:
## 1. Intake
Sample order book. No store API and no payment gateway. The manual trigger is the local run button.

## 2. Risk and margin
Fraud points: country mismatch, card mismatch, new account, velocity, and a high gross. Margin under 12% or gross over 1500 goes to review.

## 3. Desks
Invalid orders never reach stock. Rejections, reviews, backorders, parcels, and pickups each finish on their own desk.
